# Osinty: code map

around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Learn open-source intelligence (OSINT) the way private investigators use it: 24 lessons, realistic fictional case files, a field kit of tools and your own casebook.
**Live:** https://osinty.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/osinty · **Layout:** JavaScript pages + tools/deploy.py (not native Forms yet) · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/osinty/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- Edit the **project source in this folder**; GitHub only holds the built output (`tools/deploy.py` builds
  `theme/assets/app.js`/`app.css` from `web/`). Never edit `tools/.anvil-repo`.
- **New page**: `web/pages/<name>.html` with `UI.page('<name>', {title, auth, nav}, mount)`. Shared engines: `web/pages/_*.html`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in `server_code/<Module>.py`; call it from a page with `UI.api('name', {...})`.
- **New table/column**: `TABLES` in `tools/sync_to_anvil.py` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert after deploy).
- **Header, footer, tab bar**: `web/app.js`. Shared helpers: `web/core.js` (`window.UI`). Tokens + components: `web/core.css`.
- **Check**: `python -I tools/check.py --ui` → ALL CHECKS PASSED. Look: `tools/preview/devserver.py` + `tools/preview/shots.py`.
- **Deploy**: `python tools/deploy.py` (dry run), then `python tools/deploy.py --push "Message"`.
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py osinty` refreshes this map.

## Data tables (`tools/sync_to_anvil.py` TABLES)

- **users**: display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str, xp:num, streak:num, active_day:date, board_hidden:bool, kit:obj, briefing_day:date · used in Admin, Agents, DemoData
- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **progress**: user→users, lesson_id:str, module_id:str, score:num, total:num, xp:num, completed:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Academy, Admin, Agents, DemoData
- **case_runs**: user→users, case_id:str, found:obj, pinned:obj, answers:obj, hints:obj, wrong:num, searches:num, status:str, score:num, xp:num, started:dt, updated:dt, finished:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Agents, Cases, DemoData
- **investigations**: owner→users, title:str, subject:str, objective:str, status:str, checklist:obj, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Agents, Casebook
- **leads**: investigation→investigations, kind:str, value:str, note:str, source:str, grade:str, when:str, x:num, y:num, created:dt · used in Agents, Casebook
- **links**: investigation→investigations, a→leads, b→leads, label:str, created:dt · used in Agents, Casebook
- **bulletins**: title:str, body:str, kind:str, author→users, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Agents, DemoData

## Tools

- `tools/check.py`: Checks before deploying. Run from anywhere:
- `tools/deploy.py`: Deploy the project to Anvil through its GitHub repo (REPO in tools/sync_to_anvil.py).
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/sync_to_anvil.py`: Write this project into the Anvil app's git checkout (the repo Anvil syncs with GitHub).
